Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is Lucent's General Knowledge for?

One volume for the static GK syllabus: build your base from it, then use it to revise facts before a paper.

What does Lucent's General Knowledge cover?

One compact book covering Indian history, polity, geography, economy and general science in point form, which is what a first read of the GK syllabus needs.

Which exams is Lucent's General Knowledge useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Staff Selection Commission, Railway Recruitment, Central Armed Police Forces, General competitive.
